proposal_sentence_delivered_to_Main_at_1.wrong_sentence: Also ε<2√2 forces V>1/2, so the cost-ball pruning mechanism changes character there.
proposal_sentence_delivered_to_Main_at_1.correction: FALSE as stated. 2√2 comes only from the uniform product-Laplace upper cutoff N=ceil(2√2/ε); it is not a lower bound on the actual V. The half-diamond trial already gives V<=1/2 on [ε0,∞), including ε between ε0 and 2√2. The correct statement on [ε0,∞) is V<=1/2 by that explicit trial; for ε<ε0 no upper bound below 1/2 is currently proved by me, and V>1/2 there is NOT established. The cost-ball pruning character below ε0 must be argued from the actual-V cutoff i>=ceil(sqrt(2V)), never from 2√2 reversed.
